subject: Emotions
title: Public Shaming Online
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Public Shaming Online.

hook.text: Justine Sacco tweeted a bad joke to 170 followers. By the time her plane landed, she was the top trend and fired.

buildup.text: Jon Ronson documented how internet mob shaming destroys lives: job loss, harassment, and lasting mental health damage.

discovery.text: Public shaming triggers real trauma responses. Victims show PTSD symptoms identical to physical assault survivors.

twist.text: The shamers feel righteous. Brain scans show moral outrage activates reward circuits—punishing feels good.

climax.text: The internet made shaming permanent. In traditional cultures, shame faded. Online, it's indexed forever by Google.

punchline.text: The mob forgets by morning. The shamed person never does.

quiz.question: Who documented modern internet shaming culture?
